questions.stem: Which is an anaesthetic cause of failed regional anaesthesia?

What is the first management step when a regional block fails during surgery?
options: Give an IV opioid bolus immediately
Tell the surgeon and pause the operation

questions.stem: When a regional block fails, what possible reasons should be checked?
questions.answer: No block, patchy block, slow onset, receding block, anxiety.

questions.stem: If surgical closure is near when a block fails, what may be enough?
options: Full repeat of the original block
Immediate spinal re-injection at higher dose
Local infiltration or a little IV supplement

questions.stem: After a failed regional block, why communicate with the surgeon and patient?
options: Keeps trust and lowers PTSD risk
